sentences.text:
(BY SHRI S. K. SHRIVASTAVA, GOVT. ADVOCATE &
 SHRI VISHNU KUMAR UPADHYAY, ADVOCATE FOR OBJECTOR)
 This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is first bail application filed under Section 439 CrPC on behalf of applicant who is in custody since 20.4.2023 in connection with Crime No.27/2023 registered at Police Station Mahila Thana,
District Sagar (M.P.), for the offence punishable under sections 376, and 376(2)(n) of the Indian Penal Code and Section 67-B of I.T Act.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is a young boy aged about 25 years and prosecutrix is aged about 32 years.
According to prosecution story, applicant and prosecutrix were having love relationship since 2016.
Applicant is said to have given false promise to marry her and thereafter established relationship with her.
He had not intention to marry her.

Learned counsel Raja vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101467176/
1 for the applicant submitted that there is delay in lodging of FIR.

entities.text: Raja vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: There was long standing relationship between the parties and applicant did not give any false promise to marry her.
In these circumstances, applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate appearing for the respondent/State opposed the prayer for grant of bail.
4. Learned counsel for the objector also opposed the application and read over the Whatsapp messages sent by applicant to family members of prosecutrix and mother.
He is threatening the family members of prosecutrix and also prosecutrix with dire consequences.
I n these circumstances he may not be released on bail.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
5 . Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
6. Applicant is at liberty to file repeat application after examination of prosecutrix in court.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE mms Raja vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101467176/
